questions.question: Pamila is the granddaughter of Akun who is married to Nikita. Murali is the brother-in-law of Akun who has two daughters but no son. Rahul is the cousin of Kamal and brother of Pamila. Uday and Vanmay are the sons-in-law of Nikita. Vanmay is married to Yamini and they have two daughters and one son. Uday has one son and one daughter. Tina and Smita are the daughters of Yamini. Murali is unmarried. How is Yamini related to Rahul?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/820640455d2561154cca106a6fd6c43b18d10d15f60efe6faff41168866f0678.png] 

1) Pamila is the granddaughter of Akun who is married to Nikita.

2) Murali is the brother-in-law of Akun who has two daughters but no son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc34262a34d761ca1ca4d2a44cd49fcd3c3b017a54e5d2279eb8ca2bc1e97a36.png] 

3) Uday and Vanmay are the sons-in-law of Nikita.

4) Vanmay is married to Yamini and they have two daughters and one son.

5) Uday has one son and one daughter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5143103adcadcc08c36d8595088a5b0fcfdf0c9e086f23d28bde2a6f2f9e5db.png] 

6) Tina and Smita are the daughters of Yamini.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54e7053c6a77b6199cea46c6d4fecb77d5cf126978f92e61de84356a223fb223.png] 

7) Rahul is the cousin of Kamal and brother of Pamila.

8) Murali is unmarried.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbdc78db798b6c9c30c207693a8c0b3b24abb53243c120d0d9fe2add55ec5ef5.png] 

Hence, Yamini is **"Aunt"** of Rahul.

A side of a square-shaped park is 12 m. If a square-shaped garden with a side of 24 m is developed around the park, what will be the total area of the park including the garden?
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

A side of a square-shaped park is 12 m.

__
 
• If a square-shaped garden with a side of 24 m is developed around the park, then the garden with the park will look like the picture below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da399c9064752e64abcba10ba83254f0a6ea6fffde67d9fac2a4d2debc5d3235.png] 

**Formula:**__

Area of square = Side × Side

__**Calculation:**__

=> Total area of the park including the garden = Area of the outer square = 24 × 24

=> Area of square = 576 m2

Hence, the total area of the park including the garden is 576 m².

Study the given matrix carefully and select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 7
 13
 174

 104

 30
 ?
questions.solution:
Given:

 
 

 
 
7

 
 
 
13

 
 
 
174

 
 
 

 
 
9

 
 
 
25

 
 
 
104

 
 
 

 
 
11

 
 
 
30

Here the pattern followed in **each row** is:

**(1st number)³ – (2ⁿd number)² = 3rd number**

**Row 1:** (1st number)³ – (2ⁿd number)² = 3rd number

7³ - 13² = 343 - 169 = 174

**Row 2:** (1st number)³ – (2ⁿd number)² = 3rd number

9³ - 25² = 729 - 625 = 104

Similarly

**Row 3: **(1st number)³ – (2ⁿd number)² = 3rd number

11³ - 30² = 1331 - 900 = 431

Hence, **“431” **is correct answer

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

23 : 441 : : 28 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

 
• **(1st number - 2)² = 2nd number**

Now,

 
• 23 : 441

=> **(23 - 2)² = 21² = 441 = 2nd number**

Similarly,

 
• **28 : ?**

**=> (28 - 2)² = 26² = 676 = 2nd number**

Hence, **"676****"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five persons are sitting in a row facing the north. One of the two persons at the extreme ends is an introvert and the other one is an extrovert. A thin person is sitting to the immediate right of an intelligent person. A weak person is sitting to the immediate left of the extrovert person. The intelligent person is sitting exactly between the introvert and the thin persons. Which of the following persons is sitting at the centre?
questions.solution:
Given:

 
• Five persons are sitting in a row facing the north

1) One of the two persons at the extreme ends is an introvert and the other one is an extrovert.

3) A weak person is sitting to the immediate left of the extrovert person.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a47e76f00cd4e9afe17671579239d421ee4b270d6a1fc48ca36dc5909fb134d.png] 

4) The intelligent person is sitting exactly between the introvert and the thin persons.

2) A thin person is sitting to the immediate right of an intelligent person.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85024255fda57543964770138e83750b7353c53f1fe82e39d731b347347e9b51.png] 

**"Thin" person is sitting at the centre.**

 

Hence, the correct answer is "Thin".
